visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation begins with a white cartoon cat featuring a small rainbow horn sitting on a tan surface against a yellow wall. A human arm enters from the right, petting the cat's head. The cat has wide eyes and a small, twitching mouth. (2) The lights suddenly go out, casting a blue beam across the room. The cat looks toward a stylized human figure sleeping in a blue bed. (3) The cat is shown in a close-up, stroking its chin in a thinking pose with a determined expression. (4) The cat jumps onto the sleeping person and meows aggressively with a wide-open mouth, eventually using a grey megaphone. (5) In a living room setting, the cat sits on a wooden coffee table and pushes a glass fishbowl containing a small purple creature off the edge with its paw. (6) The cat jumps rapidly around the bedroom, bouncing off walls and the ceiling, eventually landing directly on the sleeping person's stomach. (7) The cat is back on a yellow couch, gagging with its eyes bulging before vomiting a massive, messy pile of grey liquid onto the cushions. (8) The cat returns to its thinking pose, looking between the options. (9) The cat looks forward with a sinister, excited grin. (10) A compilation screen appears showing various sticker designs of the cat in different poses and costumes, with text overlays and brand information.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A soft, high-frequency purring sound is accompanied by a bright, whimsical synthesizer melody at a moderate tempo. The mix is studio-clean with no background noise. (2) A sharp, mechanical click sound triggers an immediate stop to the music, followed by a momentary silence. (3) A suspenseful, rhythmic synthesizer track begins, featuring low-frequency pulses. A female voice speaks with clear articulation and professional narrative tone, asking a question in Chinese. (4) A series of high-pitched, loud cat-like meows are heard, showing high arousal. The sound transitions into a distorted, amplified version with added mid-range resonance and slight digital clipping. (5) A whoosh transition leads to a brief tapping sound followed by a loud glass-breaking sound effect with a broad spectral bandwidth. (6) Several fast whoosh sound effects with varying pitch contours are followed by percussive thud sounds and a sharp, high-pitched squeak effect. (7) Distinct gagging sounds with vocal strain are followed by a dense, wet splat sound effect, creating a chaotic acoustic texture. (8) The suspenseful music swells, ending with a bright, triumphant major chord stinger and a confident female vocal shout. (9) An upbeat, high-energy electronic outro track with a driving beat and wide frequency range accompanies the final display.
